title: Delta Goodrem and fiancé Matt Copley share rare date night pictures in Los Angeles - after they were forced to evacuate the city during shock fires
text:
By Kinta Walsh-Cotton for Daily Mail Australia
Published: 06:30 GMT, February 9, 2025 | Updated: 06:30 GMT, February 9, 2025
Delta Goodrem and Matt Copley have returned to Los Angeles after the devastating fires that devastated the city in January.
At that time, the 40 -year -old Australian pop star revealed that she and Matt, 38, were forced to “temporarily evacuate” their home near the Inferno Hollywood Hills.
But the couple, who divided their time between Sydney and Los Angeles, seemed to be in a good mood on Sunday while sharing some rare images of a recent dating night in the United States.
Matt published photos of the couple on her Instagram account, writing, ‘La 2025’, in the title.
The first image saw Delta smiling as she posed with her musician love while sitting at an outdoor restaurant restaurant.
Bending in a Brown Satin jacket, the creator of successes showed a golden clock while hiding his eyes behind a pair of tinted tones.
Delta Goodrem, 40, and Matt Copley, 38, shared some rare images of a recent dating night in Los Angeles when they return to the city after devastating fires last month
Meanwhile, Matt showed his chest in a black shirt with the first remaining buttons.
Other photos on the reel saw the remains of after the shocking fires that exploded throughout the city last month.
In a moment, Matt seemed gloomy while taking a photo with the Hollywood burnt hills as a backdrop.
Delta and Matt joined thousands of other Los Angeles residents who evacuated their homes to escape furious fires earlier this year.
The singer went to Instagram at that time to update her followers about her own security and her fiance Matt Copley, who divided her time between Australian and the United States.
Sharing an image of the Inferno wrapping the Hollywood hills, the creator of successes said that she and her partner had to “temporarily evacuate” their home in the city of Los Angeles.
‘I love this beautiful city. It has always been a home away from home to me, ‘he subtitled the disturbing image.
‘My heart is broken and the feeling in the air full of smoke is devastating. Praying for all.
The Australian pop star and her partner were forced to “temporarily evacuate” her home near Hollywood Hills Inferno
In the next slide, she wrote: “It is difficult to even start with the words to truly express the emotions that many feel at this time.”
‘I am very grateful for all your messages of support.
‘On a trip with everyone here and deeply saddened to see this beautiful city in such a devastating way.
“My thoughts, love and strength are all dealing with the unimaginable at this time.”
More than 100,000 Los Angeles residents were forced to flee their homes and dozens have been confirmed dead as a result of fire storms, which began with the Palisades fire.
The devastation in southern California began on January 7 when the combination of heavy wind and lack of rain created the perfect condition for a fire in the brush.
The Eaton fire burned more than 14,000 acres, while the fire of Palisades burned almost 24,000 acres.
The rich and working class residents are collecting the pieces after their neighborhoods of Los Angeles were reduced to ashes as forest fires crossed the city.
